entities.summary: Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono (b. 1949-09-09, Pacitan) was a public servant or civil administrator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Pacitan and Indonesia. Known in the fields of indonesia, military leaders & commanders, asia.
